title: The Door
tagline: Three wires make a door open. Then make it yours.
idea: A ROUTE carries an event from one field to another field of the same type. A click is a time. A timer turns time into a number from 0 to 1. An interpolator turns that number into a place.

challenges.title: Open it without clicking
challenges.ask: Make the door open when the pointer only hovers over the red button.
challenges.hint: isOver is a yes/no (SFBool). startTime wants a time (SFTime). The wire will be refused. Add a TimeTrigger: it turns a yes into a time.

challenges.title: Light the lamp while it moves
challenges.ask: Make the lamp change colour for as long as the door is moving.
challenges.hint: Add a ColorInterpolator. Feed it the timer's fraction_changed. Send its value_changed to LampGlow's emissiveColor. Give it key 0 0.5 1 and keyValue 0 0 0  1 0.8 0.2  0 0 0.

challenges.title: Spin, don't slide
challenges.ask: Make the door swing like a revolving door.
challenges.hint: An OrientationInterpolator makes rotations (axis x y z, then an angle in radians). Try key 0 0.5 1 and keyValue 0 1 0 0  0 1 0 3.14  0 1 0 6.28, and wire it to Door's rotation.

script:
def door():
    b = bg.Behaviour()
    click = b.add("TouchSensor", "Click", parent="Button", description="open the door")
    timer = b.add("TimeSensor", "Timer", cycleInterval=3)
    slide = b.add("PositionInterpolator", "Slide",
                  key=[0, 0.4, 0.6, 1],
                  keyValue=[(0, 1.2, 0), (0, 3.7, 0), (0, 3.7, 0), (0, 1.2, 0)])
    door = b.target("Transform", "Door")
    click.touchTime >> timer.startTime             # a click sends the time; the timer starts at that time
    timer.fraction_changed >> slide.set_fraction   # the timer counts 0 to 1; the interpolator turns that into a place
    slide.value_changed >> door.translation        # the place moves the door
    return b
